basis: Axonal neuropathy with defining acrodystrophy: persistent skin ulcers, contractures and terminal phalangeal loss. Associated osteomyelitis does not establish an intrinsic infectious mechanism.

decisions.dermatologic: primary: persistent nonhealing ulcers are part of the defining acrodystrophy.
decisions.musculoskeletal: primary: contractures and mutilating loss of terminal phalanges are defining skeletal manifestations.

basis: Tumour localized to the periocular region; meningioma histology alone does not establish brain, spinal cord or intracranial meningeal involvement.

decisions.neurologic: none: periocular meningioma can arise locally; the supplied definition does not establish CNS origin or involvement.

basis: Limb aplasia, lung hypoplasia, hydrocephalus and oral clefts each 80-99%; anal atresia 30-79%. Renal, ocular, cardiac and ear anomalies omitted at cap.

decisions.pulmonary: primary: major pulmonary malformations are in the definition; lung aplasia/hypoplasia occurs in 80-99%.
decisions.neurologic: primary: CNS malformations are in the definition; hydrocephalus occurs in 80-99% and callosal agenesis in 30-79%.

basis: Skeletal dysplasia and intellectual/developmental disability define it; ptosis occurs in 80-99%. Dental crowding alone does not establish oral dysfunction; retinal abnormalities are 5-29%.

decisions.gastrointestinal: none: dental crowding and narrow mouth are dysmorphic findings without demonstrated oral tissue damage or loss of function.

basis: Inelastic facial skin and characteristic blepharophimosis define the mask-like facial phenotype. Supplied skeletal and auricular shape variants do not establish functional damage.

decisions.ocular: primary: blepharophimosis is a characteristic eyelid malformation contributing to the defining facial phenotype.
decisions.musculoskeletal: none: supplied annotations describe minor skeletal shape variants; common damaging skeletal disease or contractures are not established.

basis: CARD11-associated dominant-negative immune dysfunction with defining severe persistent atopic dermatitis in roughly 80-90%; recurrent infections alone do not establish chronic pulmonary damage.

decisions.dermatologic: primary: severe persistent atopic dermatitis is a core manifestation of CADINS, affecting approximately 80-90%.

basis: Spastic paraplegia, dystonia and intellectual disability establish neurologic disease. Muscle wasting and sphincter dysfunction are neurogenic; intrinsic muscle disease is not established.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: amyotrophy accompanying this neurologic syndrome does not establish direct skeletal muscle disease; frequency of independent muscle pathology is unspecified.

basis: Congenital umbilical abdominal-wall closure defect with herniated bowel; no intrinsic skeletal muscle or locomotor connective-tissue disease is established.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: an umbilical closure defect does not by itself establish skeletal muscle or locomotor connective-tissue disease.

basis: Diabetes, cerebellar agenesis and pancreatic endocrine/exocrine loss define it. Optic hypoplasia and contractures each reported in 1/1 do not establish syndrome-wide frequency >=30%.

decisions.ocular: none: optic nerve hypoplasia in one annotated patient does not establish occurrence in >=30% across the syndrome and is not a major diagnostic criterion.

basis: Acidosis/aminoaciduria, intellectual disability, muscular dystrophy and osteoporosis define the phenotype. Aminoaciduria can reflect metabolic overflow; renal tubular dysfunction is not established.

decisions.renal: none: aminoaciduria and acidosis do not distinguish metabolic overflow from renal tubular dysfunction; intrinsic renal disease is not established.
decisions.neurologic: primary: intellectual disability is an explicitly defining feature of the syndrome, supported by its HPO annotation.
